question: Which five vehicle makes have the highest average original fine?

analysis.sql: SELECT vehicle_make, AVG(original_fine) AS avg_original_fine FROM "ds_4ea4f575f5f44fc19ccfff6b6c326cae" GROUP BY vehicle_make ORDER BY avg_original_fine DESC LIMIT 5
analysis.summary: The five vehicle makes with the highest average original fines are BMW (678.23 SAR), Honda (628.00 SAR), Lexus (616.30 SAR), Mitsubishi (609.23 SAR), and Chevrolet (608.93 SAR).
